claims.evidence: Photos show a device labeled “BLUE GATE” with UPS-style front indicators and a mains plug connected (photo 0, photo 1).

risks.risk: Battery health/capacity is unknown (UPS may not hold load or may shut down under power).
risks.proof: A short video of the UPS running on battery: unplug from wall, show LEDs/any battery indicator staying on for several minutes while powering a small load (e.g., router + bulb).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: battery not reliable / not holding charge (treat as needing battery replacement).

risks.risk: Output rating (VA/W) and number/type of outlets are not visible, so it may not suit the buyer’s load.
risks.proof: Photo of the label/sticker showing model number and specs (VA/W, input/output voltage, frequency, outlet ratings).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a lower-capacity/unknown-spec UPS (worst-case for buyer compatibility).

risks.risk: Whether it is fully functional (alarm faults, inverter issues, or charging faults) is not confirmed by photos.
risks.proof: Power-on test: show it charging from wall (battery/charge LED behavior) and then switch to battery with a load; include any fault/alarm indicators.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully proven functional (worst case: may have faults).

risks.risk: Physical condition/hidden damage (internal swelling, loose components) cannot be assessed from exterior photos.
risks.proof: Photo of the back and sides plus a close-up of any vents/ports; also ask for a quick shake/inspection and confirm no burning smell.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average used condition with potential hidden issues.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the UPS rating label/sticker (model number, VA/W, input/output, battery type/voltage).
Video test: unplug from wall and show it running on battery for a few minutes with a small load; show LED status throughout.
Photo of the back panel (ports/outlets) and any fault/alarm indicators during power-on.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a BLUE GATE UPS, but the key pricing drivers (model/specs and battery health/working status) are not readable or test-proven. Without those, a safe worst-case price cannot be determined.
